description: This file defines the internal sealed class CachingIdSpanCodec, which provides serialization and caching mechanisms for IdSpan objects, including reading raw data, writing raw data, and managing cache entries with periodic garbage collection.

classes.name: CachingIdSpanCodec
classes.description: A serializer for IdSpan that caches values to avoid re-encoding and unnecessary allocations, with mechanisms for cache management and garbage collection.

methods.name: ReadRaw
methods.description: Reads raw IdSpan data from a reader, utilizing cache to optimize repeated values.

methods.name: PurgeStaleEntries
methods.description: Removes cache entries that haven't been accessed within a specified time frame.

methods.name: WriteRaw
methods.description: Serializes an IdSpan value into a writer and updates the shared cache.
